slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“江先生，慢走！”

“期待您的下次光临！”

男店员微微躬身，双手奉上发票。

“刚刚是谁狗眼看人低来着？怎么不继续狗叫了？”

香菜挺了挺傲人的胸脯，冷哼道：“现在，知道我哥的实力了吧！”

“下次，再也不来这破店买东西了！”丸子提着两个大号购物袋，顺势一甩马尾。

男店员尴尬地笑着，心中窝火，却不敢当面发作。

毕竟得罪了江辰这位金主爸爸，他怕是吃不了兜着走。

......

出了便利店。

江辰没有一丝犹豫，果断叫了一辆滴滴。

和以前一年到头都不舍得打一次车相比。

眼下确实有些奢侈了。

十分钟不到。

三人一行回到了出租屋。

江辰往沙发上一躺，掏出手机。

丸子将东西放好后，开始处理那个泰国进口榴莲。

动作干净利索。

很快，就将饱满的果肉装盘，走到江辰旁边坐下。

“哥，张嘴，啊~”

那模样，就跟喂小孩似的。

江辰没抬头，张口咬下一块。

丸子有些好奇：“哥，你在干什么呢？这么入迷。”

江辰唇角微微一扬。

接着，点开了钻石会员群里某人发来的语音。

“江先生，我真知道错了！还请您大人有大量，别和我一般见识.......”

“我千不该，万不该，轻视您的两位朋友。”

“......”

香菜耳朵一动，“咦，听声音，不是便利店里那个讨人厌的死胖子吗？”

丸子恍然道：“哥，你加入那个群聊，原来是为了揭发那个死胖子！”

钻石会员群里不仅有江辰这些会员，还有便利店的老板！

当江辰把视频往群里一放，群里直接炸锅！

其他钻石会员无一不是义愤填膺，对那名男店员口诛笔伐。

便利店老板也在群里。为挽回便利店形象，给钻石客户们一个交代。

他果断拿男店员开刀！

而在几分钟前，男店员还想借拉江辰入群这事，和老板申请奖励。

却没想到，这么快就被“啪啪”打脸。

“谢谢哥！为我和香菜出气！”

话落，江辰就感觉脸颊一侧有些微热。

他如同被雷劈了一般，连忙退到沙发一角。

“你......你这是做什么？”江辰吃惊的看着丸子，脸上一副被夺了清白的表情。

丸子俏脸泛起一抹红晕，“哥，你难道不喜欢这样吗？”

咳咳......

“下次，下次不许再这样了。”江辰严肃道。

“下次？哦，原来哥还想有下一次呢！”丸子语气充满了挑逗。

江辰：“……”

看到江辰脸上的表情，香菜噗嗤一笑。

气氛有些尴尬。

江辰赶忙找了一个话题。

“说起来，你们这个年纪，不应该是在好好读书吗？”

丸子和香菜相视一眼，脸上不约而同露出了一言难尽的表情。

一番交谈后，江辰知道了她们的一些经历。

家庭层面的一些原因，她们早早就告别了校园生活，进厂打工。

也正是过早进入社会，因此比很多同龄人都要早熟。

后面因实名举报厂里的油腻组长，对女员工实施骚扰，因此被开除处理。

为了解决生活温饱，她们转而从事网络直播。

结果又因为不满工会压榨，闹掰了。

Page (1/3)

"Mr. Jiang, walk slowly!"

“Looking forward to your next visit!”

The male clerk bowed slightly and presented the invoice with both hands.

"Who was looking down on people just now? Why didn't you continue barking?"

Xiangcai puffed up her proud chest and snorted: "Now, you know my brother's strength!"

"Next time, I won't buy anything from this shabby store again!" Wanzi carried two large shopping bags and flicked his ponytail.

The male clerk smiled awkwardly, feeling angry in his heart, but he didn't dare to explode in front of her.

After all, he had offended Jiang Chen, the financial sponsor's father, and he was afraid that he would not be able to eat and carry around.

...

Exited the convenience store.

Jiang Chen didn't hesitate at all and decisively called a Didi.

Compared with the past, I was reluctant to take a taxi all year round.

It's indeed a bit of a luxury right now.

Less than ten minutes.

The three of them returned to the rental house.

Jiang Chen lay down on the sofa and took out his cell phone.

After Wanzi put the things away, he started to deal with the durian imported from Thailand.

The movement is clean and crisp.

Soon, he put the plump fruit pulp on a plate and walked to sit next to Jiang Chen.

"Brother, open your mouth, ah~"

It looked like feeding a child.

Jiang Chen didn't raise his head and opened his mouth to bite off a piece.

Wanzi was a little curious: "Brother, what are you doing? You are so fascinated."

Jiang Chen's lips raised slightly.

Then, he clicked on the voice message sent by someone in the diamond membership group.

"Mr. Jiang, I really know I was wrong! Please be patient and don't be as knowledgeable as me..."

"I should never, never should, look down upon your two friends."

"..."

Xiangcai's ears twitched, "Hey, listen to the voice, isn't he that annoying fat guy in the convenience store?"

Wanzi suddenly said: "Brother, you joined that group chat to expose that damn fat man!"

In the diamond membership group, there are not only members like Jiang Chen, but also convenience store owners!

When Jiang Chen posted the video to the group, the group went crazy!

The other diamond members were all filled with indignation and verbally criticized the male clerk.

The convenience store owner is also in the group.In order to restore the image of the convenience store, give diamond customers an explanation.

He decisively attacked the male clerk!

A few minutes ago, the male clerk wanted to use Jiang Chen to join the group and apply for a reward with the boss.

But he didn't expect to be slapped in the face so quickly.

"Thank you, brother! Take it out for me and Xiangcai!"

As soon as he finished speaking, Jiang Chen felt a slight heat on one side of his cheek.

As if struck by lightning, he quickly retreated to the corner of the sofa.

"You...what are you doing?" Jiang Chen looked at Wanzi in surprise, with an expression of innocence being taken away from him.

A blush appeared on Wanzi's pretty face, "Brother, don't you like this?"

Ahem...

"Next time, don't do this again next time." Jiang Chen said seriously.

"Next time? Oh, it turns out that I want to have a next time!" Wanzi's tone was full of teasing.

Jiang Chen: "..."

Seeing the expression on Jiang Chen's face, Xiangcai chuckled.

The atmosphere was a little awkward.

Jiang Chen quickly found a topic.

"Speaking of which, at your age, shouldn't you be studying hard?"

Wanzi and Xiangcai looked at each other, with unspeakable expressions on their faces.

After a conversation, Jiang Chen learned some of their experiences.

Due to some family reasons, they bid farewell to campus life early and went to work in factories.

It is precisely because he entered society too early that he matured earlier than many of his peers.

Later, he reported with his real name that the greasy team leader in the factory had harassed female employees and was fired.

In order to make ends meet, they turned to online live streaming.

As a result, they broke up again because they were dissatisfied with the oppression of the union.
